author: The Linux Foundation
description:
A critical piece of infrastructure that half of all cloud-native environments rely on is being retired in just six weeks, and if you don't migrate now, you could be leaving your systems wide open to attacks. Kubernetes Ingress NGINX is being shut down due to a lack of maintainers, and roughly 50% of production Kubernetes deployments could be affected. This isn't just an inconvenience—it's a serious security emergency. 
Kat Cosgrove from the Kubernetes Steering Committee and Tabitha Sable from the Kubernetes Security Response Committee break down what went wrong, your migration options, and how to protect your infrastructure before time runs out. Learn why Gateway API is the future, what can happen if you don't migrate, and why this is a wake-up call for how we maintain critical open source infrastructure.
Read the full story at www.tfir.io
#Kubernetes #CloudNative #CyberSecurity #OpenSource #DevSecOps #IngressNginx #GatewayAPI #CNCF #CloudSecurity #InfrastructureAsCode
title: Why Half of All Kubernetes Clusters Are About to Become Vulnerable | Kat Cosgrove & Tabitha Sable
